overview: P0 E2E validation of evidence trust loop: source jump, highlight verification, trust metadata rendering, and fail-closed citation recovery.
goals: Protect the highest-risk citation trust workflow.
Guarantee explicit verification posture at 100% zoom.
Enforce fail-closed behavior for invalid citations.
successMetrics: Valid citation path renders highlight overlay and trust metadata.
Invalid citation path shows deterministic `citation_failed` reason with no overlay.

routes.name: Viewer Fallback Route
routes.purpose: Direct viewer path for seeded scenarios

uiNotes: Viewer must expose `Reset to 100% to verify` behavior.
Trust footer fields (`doc_version`, `verified_at`, `loaded_state`) must be payload-backed.
`Flag citation wrong` remains UI acknowledgement only in this slice.

importFormat.description: Scenario uses seeded citations with one valid and one intentionally broken anchor.

rules: Source jumps are clickable only when anchor-ready.
Failed citations must never render highlight overlay.

stories.title: Verify Evidence and Fail Closed on Citation Errors
stories.description: As a reviewer, I need source-to-evidence verification to be explicit for valid citations and fail closed for invalid ones.
acceptanceCriteria: Given one valid and one broken citation, both are accessible from report/chat source chips.
When opening the valid citation, viewer renders PDF highlight overlay and trust metadata with explicit verification controls.
Then reset-to-100 action restores verifiable state and trust posture.
Example: valid citation renders one or more highlight polygons and no `citation_failed` panel.
Negative: broken citation renders deterministic `citation_failed` reason and zero highlight polygons.
